stories.headline: NEOM and Vision 2030 megaprojects face sweeping scale-back as financial and regional pressures mount
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia suspended major work on The Line beyond 2030, cancelled NEOM's high-speed Connector Rail built by Webuild, scaled back The Cube and Trojena, and cut multiple construction contracts affecting an estimated 80,000 Nepali workers. BBC, Bloomberg, and multiple outlets linked the retrenchment to falling oil prices before the Iran war and ballooning estimated project costs, now reportedly reaching $9 trillion for NEOM alone. PIF simultaneously released a 2026-2030 strategy repositioning NEOM around logistics, AI data centres, and tourism rather than the original sci-fi residential concept.

stories.headline: Death of former Yemeni President Hadi prompts Saudi condolences and debate over legal basis for Saudi-Yemen operations

King Salman and MBS issued formal condolences; Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman and Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan attended condolence gatherings with Hadi's family.
